method: Recorded timer duration, not elapsed duration. Consecutive ACTIVE laps merged until other intensity. HR weighted by lap duration. November context and March23-29 bridge excluded from maincycle. No numeric historical HR zone boundaries supplied. No pre-Jan26 plan supplied. No claim of causal training effect or illness cause. Distances do not measure workout compliance. Workout phases are additionally grouped by consecutive (workout_step_index, intensity_type), since ACTIVE can include both easy and faster phases.
